subject.title: [Bug]: Signal daemon stop() race condition on SIGUSR1 restart — orphaned processes and send failures

question: Should maintainers accept the scoped proof on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/71863 and land it, or require a live linked Signal restart proof first?
rationale: The source-level bug and focused fix path are clear, but this read-only issue review cannot decide the remaining maintainer acceptance threshold for live Signal-account proof before merge.

options.title: Land the focused PR
options.body: Accept the existing proof and merge the Signal-owned async shutdown fix, leaving broader iMessage/Gmail process cleanup to separate work if needed.

options.title: Request live Signal restart proof
options.body: Keep the issue and linked PR open until a maintainer or contributor provides a linked-account Signal config hot-reload restart transcript or logs.

options.title: Close the PR and sponsor an equivalent fix
options.body: If maintainers dislike the exact PR shape, keep this issue as canonical and replace it with an equivalent Signal lifecycle repair.

recommendation.title: Land the focused PR
recommendation.body: Accept the existing proof and merge the Signal-owned async shutdown fix, leaving broader iMessage/Gmail process cleanup to separate work if needed.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the live assignee and have already said they would reproduce and investigate this exact orphaned signal-cli behavior.
